high_level_description: This image is a screenshot of a YouTube video page for the song "Ramayana (The Introduction Theme)" by Hans Zimmer. The video has garnered 19 lakh views and was uploaded 4 weeks ago. The channel associated with the video is Hans Zimmer, who has 14.8 lakh subscribers. The poster at the top of the image features artwork related to the Ramayana, a Hindu epic. It depicts two characters, one on the left and one on the right, set against a cosmic background with stars and nebulae. The text on the poster reads: "OUR TRUTH. OUR HISTORY."
